summary: A GitHub repository observer that resumes from another member's read position reads the open listing once to learn open items' identities, so a transfer of an old open issue is seen; forgetting an observer's plugin-database row no longer reads the database on every reconcile pass.

replay.detail: No claim is written, rewritten or replayed.

schema.detail: No schema change. The GitHub plugin database's table and version are unchanged; forget() keeps an in-memory set of observers known to have no row. Correction to github-cursor-plugin-database: an unusable plugin database is set aside and replaced by an empty one, and the daemon starts; it does not start only when the directory cannot be made, the file cannot be moved aside, or no database opens in its place, and the error names the path.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes, and no fleet coordination.

compatibility.detail: No claim, client, wire or harness contract change. A member resuming without a plugin-database row makes one extra conditional REST read (issues?state=open) on its first poll, inside the github-admission budget. Older builds are unaffected.

recovery.detail: Rolling back returns to not seeding identities on a resume; nothing persisted changes.
